extracted.intended_audience: early-career clinician-scientists / biomedical researchers preparing an NIH K08 mentored career development (Parent K08) application
extracted.subtask_description: A sample NIH K08 (Mentored Clinical Scientist Research Career Development Award) application showing required forms, research strategy (specific aims, methods, timeline), training plan (including Responsible Conduct of Research), institutional environment, human subjects/resource sharing, and authentication plans. Useful as a model for preparing K08 submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow the funding opportunity's instructions / application format
rubrics_metrics.description: Always follow your funding opportunity's instructions for application format.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The samples may not reflect the latest format or rules; NIAID posts new samples periodically. Use the FOA-specific instructions when preparing your application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required SF424 R&R and PHS-398 application components
rubrics_metrics.description: The application must include the SF424 R&R cover page and the PHS-398 Career Development Award components (as reflected in the Table of Contents): Project Summary/Abstract, Project Narrative, Bibliography & References Cited, Facilities & Other Resources, Equipment, Senior/Key Person, Research & Related Budget (Years 1–5), Budget Justification, PHS398 Cover Page Supplement, PHS 398 Career Development Award sections (Candidate Information and Goals for Career Development, Specific Aims, Research Strategy), Training in the Responsible Conduct of Research, Mentor and Co-Mentor Statements, Letters of Support, Description of Institutional Environment, Institutional Commitment, Human Subjects and Clinical Trials Information, Select Agent Research, Resource Sharing, Authentication of Key Resources.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include all named sections in the application package; the Table of Contents indicates the standard organization expected for a K08 submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project Summary / Abstract content and focus
rubrics_metrics.description: Project Summary/Abstract should concisely state the problem, hypothesis, specific aims, methods to be used, cohorts/trials/samples, and the anticipated contribution to the field and the applicant's career development.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: summarize significance (SoIRs have higher mortality), hypothesis (LR size/inducibility correlates with suboptimal immune response), Aims 1–3, methods (IPDA, QVOA, cohorts and clinical trials to be used), and training outcomes (skills the PI will acquire). Attach as Project_Summary_Abstract.pdf.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project Narrative: public-health relevance statement
rubrics_metrics.description: A brief Project Narrative should state the public-health relevance of the proposed work (why it matters for patients/populations).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example provided: determining whether LR size/inducibility contribute to suboptimal immune response will provide critical information to develop therapeutics for a high-risk population.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Strategy structure and content expectations
rubrics_metrics.description: Research Strategy should present Specific Aims and for each aim provide methods, experimental design, anticipated results, potential problems and alternative strategies, and a timeline/milestones.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The sample demonstrates describing cohorts/trials and assays (IPDA, QVOA), experimental design, anticipated results, a Formal 'Potential Problems & Alternative Strategies' section, and a Gantt-like timeline (Table 3). Explicitly include limitations (e.g., fixed sample size from banked samples) and contingency plans.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specific Aims: clearly stated goals/hypotheses
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific Aims must articulate the study hypotheses and the discrete aims that will test them (e.g., correlation of LR size/inducibility with SoIR phenotype; effect of cytokine therapies on LR).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Aims should be testable and linked to methods and cohorts/trials; each aim should have associated assays and analytic approaches described in Research Strategy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Potential Problems & Alternative Strategies section
rubrics_metrics.description: Applications should include an explicit discussion of potential problems, study limitations, and alternative approaches/strategies to address them.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: use of banked samples limits sample size and the study must acknowledge inability to vary sample size and propose alternatives or mitigation approaches.

rubrics_metrics.name: Anticipated Results and interpretation
rubrics_metrics.description: State the expected outcomes for each aim and the interpretation/implications if hypotheses are supported or not.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples in the sample: expectations that IL-7/IL-15 will increase intact proviruses and IL-2 may reduce LR; discuss how these outcomes would affect enthusiasm for therapies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project timeline and milestones (Gantt-like plan)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a timeline (quarterly/yearly) mapping activities (sample/data analysis, manuscript writing, R01 preparation) across the award period (Years 1–5).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The sample includes a table outlining when each aim's analyses and manuscript writing will occur, and when career milestones (R01 submission) are planned.

rubrics_metrics.name: Training in the Responsible Conduct of Research (RCR) must meet NIH policy components
rubrics_metrics.description: RCR plan must cover the five instructional components outlined in NIH policy: Format, Subject Matter, Faculty Participation, Duration of Instruction, and Frequency of Instruction.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The sample specifies completed and planned training (CITI 5.5-hour course, retake every four years), face-to-face colloquia attendance, informal mentor discussions, and plans to exceed suggested contact hours (2–3 formal hours per year plus informal contact). It explicitly maps planned activities to the five components.

rubrics_metrics.name: RCR subject matter expectations
rubrics_metrics.description: RCR instruction should cover research misconduct, data acquisition and management, responsible authorship, peer review, mentoring, conflicts of interest/commitment, collaborative research, policies for handling misconduct, responsible authorship/publication, and ethical/social impacts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The sample lists these topics as part of the RCR curriculum and indicates participation in department/institutional colloquia and mentor-led discussions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Human subjects protections and documentation
rubrics_metrics.description: The application must state whether human subjects are involved, whether the project is exempt, exemption number (if applicable), IRB approval or pending status, and provide explanations for use of specimens/data.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The sample describes use of de-identified, banked blood/tissue samples from cohorts and trials, that investigators in cohorts may hold identities (but PI does not), and that privacy protections follow cohort/trial protocols. Attach Human_Subjects_Explanation.pdf.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of banked/secondary specimens and limitations
rubrics_metrics.description: When using stored samples from cohorts/trials, document source cohorts/trials, de-identification procedures, what clinical data accompany samples, and note constraints (e.g., fixed sample size, inability to prospectively collect additional data).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sample lists cohorts/trials (SCOPE, JHHCC, CLIF, ALLRT, ESPRIT, ICARUS, ILIADE, ACTG 5214, NCT02191098) and states samples are de-identified prior to transfer; discusses implications for study design and sample size.

rubrics_metrics.name: Resource Sharing / Data Sharing Plan requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Specify plans for sharing generated data/resources (e.g., deposit HIV env sequences in GenBank and Los Alamos HIV Sequence Database; publish assay results).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The sample commits to depositing annotated HIV env sequences in GenBank and states results will be published. Include applicable data/resource sharing attachments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authentication of key biological and chemical resources
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe provenance, storage, handling, quality control, and verification procedures for biological materials, cell lines, and reagents used in assays (e.g., PBMCs, tissue, isolation kits, cell lines, primers/probes).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sample details: cryopreserved PBMCs/tissues collected by cohorts, shipped on dry ice, stored in liquid nitrogen to minimize freeze-thaw cycles; cells counted after thaw; Miltenyi CD4+ isolation kits with vendor QC; resting CD4 isolation within 24 hours of thaw with purity confirmed by flow cytometry (PE Mouse Anti-Human CD4 antibody); MOLT-4 cell line sourced from Sigma-Aldrich with certificate of analysis and monitored twice weekly for contamination; primers/probes from IDT aliquoted to minimize freeze-thaw; include negative controls on every IPDA/QVOA plate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assay-specific quality control and negative controls
rubrics_metrics.description: For molecular and culture-based assays (IPDA, QVOA, QVIA), include negative controls every plate, reagent aliquoting to prevent freeze-thaw, and monitoring for contamination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The sample specifies negative controls on every IPDA and QVOA plate, aliquoting primers/probes after receipt, and routine microscopy checks/limited culture duration for cell lines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Facilities & institutional environment expectations
rubrics_metrics.description: Document available laboratory space, BSL facilities, equipment (e.g., ddPCR), institutional cores and resources (CFAR cores), mentorship structures, and training opportunities that support the research and career development.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The sample describes Siliciano lab space, dedicated ddPCR setup, JH CFAR cores (Administrative, Developmental, Clinical, Prevention, Laboratory), mentoring, weekly lab meetings, grant-writing programs (K2R Club), ICTR K-to-R transition program, and departmental junior faculty supports.

rubrics_metrics.name: Letters of support, mentor statements, and institutional commitment
rubrics_metrics.description: Include formal Plans and Statements of Mentor/Co-Mentors, Letters of Support from collaborators/contributors/consultants, and a statement of institutional commitment to the candidate's career development.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Table of Contents shows these attachments (Mentor Plans, Letters of Support, Institutional Commitment) are expected and the application narrative describes mentoring roles and institutional programs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Administrative certifications, assurances, and authorized representative signature
rubrics_metrics.description: Applications must include required certifications and assurances, and signature/date by an authorized institutional representative certifying the truthfulness of application statements and agreeing to comply with award terms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The SF424 includes a certification statement referencing criminal penalties for false claims and requires the authorized representative's signature and date (e.g., Katrina Alston-Rodgers signed 05/04/2018).

rubrics_metrics.name: Human subjects / clinical trials reporting fields and indicators
rubrics_metrics.description: Use standard form fields to indicate human subjects involvement, vertebrate animals, proprietary information, environmental impact, historic place status, international activities, and to attach relevant documents (Project Narrative, Project Summary, Bibliography, Facilities, Equipment).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The R&R Other Project Information section (checkboxes and attachments) must be completed; example shows checkboxes for human subjects, vertebrate animals, proprietary information, environment impact, historic designation, international activities, and file attachments for summary, narrative, references, facilities, equipment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Select Agent Research declaration
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate whether the project involves select agent research and provide applicable documentation, or state 'Not applicable'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The sample includes a 'Select Agent Research' page and indicates 'Not applicable' for this project.
